description: Agent Governance: submit purchases, each with its quoted or recorded terms and the governing published or contract terms (price, scope and cancellation, with where each came from) and whether the two were compared before payment. The signed report names every mismatch between the terms the purchase was made on and the governing terms, with a price difference in percent of the governing price, and every purchase paid with no terms comparison before payment. One service’s terms are wever_service-terms-check, terms changing over time are wever_terms-change-check and settled money against invoices is wever_settlement-reconciliation-check. Verdict terms_mismatch, compared_late, match_unverified or terms_match. POST /api/terms-match-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-governance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-governance/.
